title: Implement Codex repository ExecutorAdapter
businessObjective: Use Codex for approved bounded repository preparation without granting it orchestration, policy, authorization, verification, or audit authority.
technicalObjective: Implement the Codex repository ExecutorAdapter for repository analysis, bounded code and content changes, approved tests, branch and pull-request preparation, and repair-task preparation through canonical task envelopes and structured results.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, merge, or live credential access is authorized.
Deterministic policy, authenticated approval, durable workflow, dispatch, and independent verification occur outside this adapter.
The Pi service, worker, Codex CLI adapter, and durable state are initially co-located on the Mac Mini but remain separate logical components.
acceptanceCriteria: The implementation conforms to the ExecutorAdapter boundary and consumes only canonical approved task envelopes; caller or model input cannot redefine paths, commands, capabilities, policy, or approval authority.
Supported work is limited to repository analysis, bounded code or content changes, approved tests, branch and pull-request preparation, and bounded repair-task preparation.

The adapter returns schema-valid structured results for success, denial, provider unavailability, timeout, cancellation, malformed input, and execution failure without claiming authorization or verification.

It cannot schedule work, own durable workflow or queue state, authorize or approve a proposal, modify policy, verify itself as sole completion authority, merge, deploy, or become the audit source of truth.
Tier 0/shadow output stops at evidence, a bounded local change, or an authorized branch or draft pull request and performs no production-impacting action.
Required tests pass and independent verification confirms forbidden paths were untouched.
requiredChecks: provider failure timeout cancellation and malformed-input handling
solEscalationTriggers: Any executor behavior would add policy, authorization, approval, scheduling, durable workflow, audit, merge, deployment, credential, or production authority.
Any repository scope, command, workspace isolation, timeout, cancellation, privacy, or independent-verification ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Disable and revert the Codex repository adapter branch; preserve the durable task, provider-state, execution-result, and independent verification evidence.

stateTransitions.reason: Added by GOV-032 remediation to separate the bounded Codex repository executor from provider transport and dispatcher authority.
